rows.label: CRT shader
rows.hint: The television's picture for every console that had one.

by_value.Performance: Performance: a plain scanline and the mask, for a weak machine.
by_value.Balanced: Balanced: the mask and the bloom at half strength. Accurate costs 3× more; Performance is a plain scanline.
by_value.Accurate: Accurate: the whole tube, its glow, glass and phosphors, at three times Balanced's cost.
by_value.Off: Off: the console's pixels as they are, with no television.
by_value.*: Each console keeps its own; Left and Right set one for them all.

rows.label: Shader levers
rows.hint: The CRT's own levers for one console: the mask, the bloom, the scanlines and the glass.

pane.caption: {running} · live preview
muted: A opens its levers; each one redraws the picture.

rows.label: Shaders
rows.hint: The shader each console draws with: the built-in filters, the recent ones and the slang pack's presets.

pane.sentence: Text size scales every word on the big screen; nothing is cut off at any size.

by_value.On: Nothing moves: a page appears at once, and a fade takes a moment.
by_value.Off: Pages and shelves move as they are drawn to.
by_value.*: The desktop's own setting: full motion.

muted: Applies at once, on the big screen.

pane.sentence: Dark is the big screen's default; Light follows the desktop's choice when you ask it to.
The game's volume. On the handheld this row defers to the device's quick menu.

by_value.System default: The game and the interface's sounds play where the system sends sound.
by_value.*: The game and the interface's sounds play on {value}.

muted: A device not connected when EmuSen starts falls back to the system default.

rows.label: ROM folder
rows.hint: The folder the library lists, read in place and never moved.

pane.sentence: {games} under {value}, read in place and never moved.
muted: A opens the folder picker; new games are found on the next start or with Check Again in the Library Manager.

rows.label: Artwork folder
rows.hint: Box art, named like the game's file; blank keeps it beside the games.

rows.label: Themes
rows.hint: The big picture's look: EmuSen's own, or an ES-DE theme's; A opens the themes and their options.

rows.label: Scraping
rows.hint: Where art and facts come from, and what is fetched.

rows.label: Collections
rows.hint: The automatic collections shown, your own, and how lists are sorted.

rows.label: Cheats
rows.hint: The cheats of the game last played, turned on or off, and the cheat database.

rows.label: Compressed discs
rows.hint: The library's discs converted to CHD beside them, checked and listed; the library is only read.

rows.label: ES-DE media folder
rows.hint: An ES-DE downloaded_media folder whose art the theme shows; only ever read.

rows.label: ES-DE theme folder
rows.hint: A theme folder for ES-DE to read in place, which then joins the themes.

rows.label: Saves and states
rows.hint: Where states go, what happens when a game starts again, and how play time is counted.

pane.sentence: States and saves live beside the games, with one resume point kept per game.

rows.label: Logging
rows.hint: Whether the runtime writes its log, and where each session's log goes.

rows.label: Shell
rows.hint: DianaSh, EmuSen's own shell, for scripts and the runtime's commands.

words.no_engine: EmuSen has no engine for the {console} yet.
words.shares: What every {console} game shares, unless the game's own options say otherwise.
words.heading: The {console}'s {group} settings.
words.engine: {engine}, the {console}'s engine: every {console} game opens on it unless the game's own options choose another.
words.engine_others: {others} can be chosen here too; this is the same setting as Cores' Make Default.
words.choose: A chooses; B keeps what was chosen.
words.cartridge: The {console}'s games keep their saves in the cartridge; there is no card to choose.

page.label: Firmware
page.hint: The firmware the {console}'s engines use, found by its content in your folders.

page.label: Memory cards
page.hint: The {console}'s cards: shared by every game as the console's were, or one per game.
page.none: The {console}'s games keep their saves in the cartridge.

page.label: CRT profile
page.hint: The television the {console}'s picture is drawn on.

page.label: Shader levers
page.hint: The CRT's own levers for the {console}.

pane.sentence: The whole picture, the part a television showed, or a crop of your own.

page.label: Screen
page.hint: The {console}'s screen as it is drawn.

pane.sentence: The screen the console was made for, or each pixel square.

page.label: Reset this console
page.hint: Every {console} setting back to its default: the engine's rows, its picture and its shaders; a row the engine holds stays.

firmware.label: Open replacement
firmware.hint: Whether the console's open replacement runs in place of firmware of your own. Takes effect when a game is next loaded.

words.auto: In use when none is found

by_value.In use when none is found: Your own firmware runs where it is found; where it is not, the open replacement runs in its place.
by_value.Always: The open replacement runs even where your own firmware is found.
by_value.Never: Only your own firmware runs: a game whose firmware is not found does not start, and says which file it needs.

muted: Takes effect when a game is next loaded. EmuSen never downloads firmware.

firmware.label: Folder
firmware.hint: Your firmware folder, searched before EmuSen's; only ever read.

firmware.label: Use EmuSen's folder alone
firmware.hint: Forgets your folder; firmware is then looked for in EmuSen's own.

firmware.label: Open EmuSen's folder
firmware.hint: EmuSen's own firmware folder in the file manager, made if it is not there yet.

firmware.label: Check again
firmware.hint: Reads the folders again, as after a file is put in one.
